$comment: Phase 0 baseline metrics for the Forgel mobile-first roadmap. Every number here was measured, not estimated. Later phases compare against this file; regressions are build failures. See plans/2026-08-05-000000--forgel-mobile-first-design-tool-roadmap.md

build.$note: Phase 4. Entry chunk was 2,067,000 bytes / 572,000 gzip as one monolith. vendor-firebase is now 50% of the eager payload and is the next target.

src/engine.$note: Both legacy engine modules are fully characterized. Phase 1 replaces them; this coverage is what makes the swap detectable.

lint.$note: Was 217 errors at audit, 11 after Phase 0-4. Now 0. Remaining warnings are 125 no-unused-vars in files later phases rewrite, plus 12 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps deferred to Phase 1.

source.$note: App.tsx was 2,994 LOC at audit and is now 991 — a dead-code sweep removed ~2,000 lines that ESLint verified were unreachable, residue of functionality that had moved into the view components.

e2e.$note: 11 flows x 2 viewports: boot, horizontal-overflow guard, project lifecycle, navigation with lazy-chunk checks, PWA installability. The two speculative specs that had never run were removed.

performance.$measuredWith: External font host blocked, so it fails fast rather than hanging on this sandbox's dead outbound network. This isolates application performance.
performance.$correction: The Phase 0 baseline recorded FCP 14996 ms and attributed it to the 572 kB bundle. THAT ATTRIBUTION WAS WRONG. A request-timeline trace showed all application JavaScript arriving in 87 ms, followed by a 12.7 s stall waiting on a render-blocking `@import url(fonts.googleapis.com)` at the top of src/index.css. Removing that blocking import is what moved FCP; the bundle work is a separate, real, but smaller win.

notMeasuredYet.$note: Still outstanding; needs tooling or hardware not available in this environment.

modulesDeleted: src/schema.ts (dead, CRDT design preserved in docs/yjs-mapping.md)
deadCodeRemoved.$caution: Automated unused-variable removal is not safe by default: it removed one statement whose RETURN VALUE was unused but which had a side effect (an await handleUpdateAndSync call in Studio.tsx). Caught by the resulting empty-block lint error and restored. Any future sweep must audit removed call expressions, not just bindings.
